_comment: Feature 089 (T014): the agent and tool catalog the routing fixtures are
labeled against. Agent ids and tool names are the real bundled ones, so a
fixture that passes here means something about the product; the
descriptions are abridged, because the corpus is about routing decisions
and not about the wording of a catalog entry.
No prompt or answer in this directory carries a credential, a key prefix,
PHI, or any real patient, user or institutional record.
